SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING avg_principal_overdue_days > 90
ORDER BY avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 0) AS total_exposure
    FROM exposure_group eg
    LEFT JOIN exposure_group_member egm
        ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld
        ON ld.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
        )
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
        ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    ge.exposure_group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure, 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM group_exposure ge
JOIN group_capital gc
    ON ge.institution_id = gc.institution_id
WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ip.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS np_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(ld.loan_id), 6) AS np_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ip ON op.industry_code = ip.sector_code
LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
LEFT JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ip.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY np_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    borrower_party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY borrower_party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    total_guaranteed_amount > 500000000
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING total_contract_amount > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(d.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(d.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS overdue_record_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    (r.deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND r.completion_date IS NULL)
    OR (r.deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(r.record_id) >= 20
ORDER BY
    overdue_record_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(sub_rc.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification sub_rc
      WHERE sub_rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON lbs.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) > 100000000
ORDER BY
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS restricted_amount,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
GROUP BY inst.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    mha.asset_id,
    mha.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot mha ON wp.product_id = mha.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON mha.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

WITH GuarantorParties AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
BorrowerParties AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    gp.guarantee_count,
    bp.agreement_count
FROM GuarantorParties gp
INNER JOIN BorrowerParties bp ON gp.guarantor_party_id = bp.borrower_party_id
INNER JOIN party p ON gp.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY gp.guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    op_industry.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ca_industry.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector op_industry ON op.industry_code = op_industry.sector_code
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ca_industry ON ca.target_industry_code = ca_industry.sector_code
WHERE op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    from_party.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    to_party.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder from_holder ON from_acc.account_id = from_holder.account_id AND from_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder to_holder ON to_acc.account_id = to_holder.account_id AND to_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party from_party ON from_holder.party_id = from_party.party_id
JOIN party to_party ON to_holder.party_id = to_party.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = from_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = to_party.party_id)
    OR (pr.source_party_id = to_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = from_party.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN institution i ON acc.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING cnt >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT
    so.staff_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cnt
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN organization_profile op ON ah.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY so.staff_id
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    t.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    t.event_date,
    t.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(t.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 t
JOIN institution i ON t.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE t.deadline_date IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE balance_rank = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_with_industry AS (
    SELECT 
        llb.loan_id,
        llb.principal_balance,
        op.industry_code
    FROM latest_loan_balance llb
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON llb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lwi.industry_code,
        lwi.loan_id,
        lwi.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lwi.industry_code ORDER BY lwi.principal_balance DESC) as rnk
    FROM loan_with_industry lwi
)
SELECT 
    isector.sector_name_zh,
    rl.loan_id,
    ROUND(rl.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    rl.rnk
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN industry_sector isector ON rl.industry_code = isector.sector_code
WHERE rl.rnk <= 3
ORDER BY isector.sector_name_zh ASC, rl.rnk ASC;

WITH daily_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM daily_counts
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > ia.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
INNER JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
INNER JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_id IS NULL
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
        ELSE '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot
WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END ASC;

SELECT
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
    collateral_valuation
GROUP BY
    collateral_id,
    valued_on
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
    collateral_id ASC;

WITH loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        ls.borrower_party_id,
        ls.loan_count,
        ls.total_principal_balance,
        ROUND(ls.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ls.loan_count, 2) AS avg_loan_amount
    FROM loan_stats ls
    WHERE ls.loan_count > 0
)
SELECT
    p.display_name,
    rc.loan_count,
    rc.total_principal_balance,
    rc.avg_loan_amount
FROM ranked_customers rc
JOIN party p ON rc.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
ORDER BY rc.avg_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.customer_segment,
    COUNT(pp.party_id) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(pp.party_id), 6) AS high_income_ratio
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY pp.customer_segment
ORDER BY pp.customer_segment ASC;

WITH payment_agg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT o1.institution_id FROM account a1 JOIN organization_unit ou1 ON a1.org_unit_id = ou1.org_unit_id WHERE a1.account_id = pe.from_account_id LIMIT 1),
            (SELECT o2.institution_id FROM account a2 JOIN organization_unit ou2 ON a2.org_unit_id = ou2.org_unit_id WHERE a2.account_id = pe.to_account_id LIMIT 1)
        ) AS institution_id,
        pe.from_account_id,
        pe.to_account_id,
        pe.amount
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
),
account_holders AS (
    SELECT
        pa.institution_id,
        pa.from_account_id,
        pa.to_account_id,
        pa.amount,
        (SELECT ah.party_id FROM account_holder ah WHERE ah.account_id = pa.from_account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' ORDER BY ah.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) AS from_party_id,
        (SELECT ah.party_id FROM account_holder ah WHERE ah.account_id = pa.to_account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' ORDER BY ah.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_agg pa
),
related_payments AS (
    SELECT
        ah.institution_id,
        ah.amount
    FROM account_holders ah
    WHERE ah.from_party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND ah.to_party_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM party_relation pr
          WHERE pr.source_party_id = ah.from_party_id
            AND pr.target_party_id = ah.to_party_id
            AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
      )
),
institution_stats AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount), 0) AS related_amount,
        SUM(ah.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM institution i
    LEFT JOIN related_payments rp ON i.institution_id = rp.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holders ah ON i.institution_id = ah.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    related_amount,
    total_amount,
    ROUND(related_amount * 1.0 / total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM institution_stats
WHERE total_amount > 0
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
INNER JOIN payment_card pc
    ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
    AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
INNER JOIN account a
    ON p.party_id = a.account_id
    AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
INNER JOIN term_deposit td
    ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        l.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY l.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot l
    WHERE l.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM RankedLoans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        cp.industry_code
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile cp ON ca.borrower_party_id = cp.party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND cp.industry_code IS NOT NULL
),
industry_stats AS (
    SELECT
        is_.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance lb
    JOIN industry_sector is_ ON lb.industry_code = is_.sector_code
    GROUP BY is_.sector_name_zh
),
ranked_industries AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total_balance
    FROM industry_stats
)
SELECT
    industry_name,
    ROUND(total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total_balance, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked_industries
WHERE cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total_balance <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valued_on = (
    SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
    FROM collateral_valuation cv2
    WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
)
AND cv.valuation_amount > 2.0 * sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM
    account a
JOIN
    party p ON a.account_id IN (
        SELECT ah.account_id
        FROM account_holder ah
        WHERE ah.party_id = p.party_id
    )
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    from_account_id,
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM
    payment_event
WHERE
    from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    from_account_id,
    business_date
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_loan_balance
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id
        FROM credit_agreement ca
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    )
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    total_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) AS security_contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) > 1
    AND SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ls.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot ls
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ls.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ls.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ls.overdue_since)) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE
    pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY
    pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t2.display_name,
    t1.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement AS t1
JOIN party AS t2
    ON t1.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
WHERE t2.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND t1.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t1.contract_amount DESC

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
LEFT JOIN industry_sector isec ON ca.target_industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE
    lpc.is_working_capital = 1
    AND isec.risk_category = 'EXIT'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2.0 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

WITH all_institution_credit AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_credit_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
non_related_party_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.target_party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
),
non_related_institution_credit AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_credit_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (SELECT target_party_id FROM non_related_party_ids)
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nic.non_related_credit_amount, 0) AS non_related_amount,
    aic.total_credit_amount AS total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(nic.non_related_credit_amount, 0) * 1.0 / aic.total_credit_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM all_institution_credit aic
JOIN institution i ON aic.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN non_related_institution_credit nic ON aic.institution_id = nic.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

WITH borrower_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
concentration_calc AS (
    SELECT
        inst.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        blb.total_loan_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        ROUND(blb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
    FROM borrower_loan_balance blb
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON blb.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    JOIN institution inst ON blb.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON blb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    total_loan_balance,
    net_capital,
    concentration_ratio
FROM concentration_calc
WHERE concentration_ratio > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.target_industry_code,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) as avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
),
loan_details AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        p.display_name as borrower_name,
        ca.annual_interest_rate,
        ca.target_industry_code,
        iavg.avg_rate as industry_avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN industry_avg_rate iavg ON ca.target_industry_code = iavg.target_industry_code
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT 
    ld.agreement_id,
    ld.borrower_name,
    ld.annual_interest_rate,
    ld.industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ld.annual_interest_rate - ld.industry_avg_rate) * 100.0 / ld.industry_avg_rate, 2) as float_pct
FROM loan_details ld
WHERE ld.industry_avg_rate > 0
  AND (ld.annual_interest_rate - ld.industry_avg_rate) * 100.0 / ld.industry_avg_rate > 10
ORDER BY float_pct DESC, ld.agreement_id ASC;

WITH latest_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_to_agreement AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
),
borrower_total_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        lta.institution_id,
        lta.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_to_agreement lta
    JOIN latest_loan_balance lb ON lta.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    GROUP BY lta.institution_id, lta.borrower_party_id
),
exceeding_customers AS (
    SELECT
        bte.institution_id,
        bte.borrower_party_id
    FROM borrower_total_exposure bte
    JOIN latest_capital lc ON bte.institution_id = lc.institution_id
    WHERE lc.net_capital > 0
      AND ROUND(bte.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital, 6) > 0.10
),
customer_type_check AS (
    SELECT
        ec.institution_id
    FROM exceeding_customers ec
    JOIN party p ON ec.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ctc.institution_id) AS exceeding_customer_count
FROM customer_type_check ctc
JOIN institution i ON ctc.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY exceeding_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id 
        AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
group_concentration AS (
    SELECT 
        ge.exposure_group_id,
        ge.group_name,
        ge.total_balance,
        gc.net_capital,
        ROUND(ge.total_balance * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
    FROM group_exposure ge
    JOIN group_capital gc ON ge.institution_id = gc.institution_id
    WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    exposure_group_id,
    group_name,
    total_balance,
    net_capital,
    concentration_ratio
FROM group_concentration
WHERE concentration_ratio > 0.1
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_interval
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = ld.loan_account_id
    AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
    AND pe.business_date <= date(ld.disbursed_on, '+7 days')
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY days_interval ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH institution_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
loan_balance_latest AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
borrower_loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbl.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_latest lbl ON ld.loan_id = lbl.loan_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
borrower_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        ble.institution_id,
        ble.borrower_party_id,
        ble.total_loan_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        ROUND(ble.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ble.institution_id ORDER BY ble.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital DESC) AS rn
    FROM borrower_loan_exposure ble
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON ble.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    br.exposure_ratio
FROM borrower_ranking br
JOIN institution i ON br.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON br.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE br.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS grade
FROM (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ca.institution_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
ORDER BY grade ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        lds.loan_id,
        lds.principal_balance,
        ca.institution_id
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
institution_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(principal_balance) AS total_institution_balance
    FROM loan_balance
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.loan_id,
        inst.institution_name,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / it.total_institution_balance * 100, 2) AS balance_ratio_percent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY inst.institution_name 
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / it.total_institution_balance DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance lb
    JOIN institution_totals it ON lb.institution_id = it.institution_id
    JOIN institution inst ON lb.institution_id = inst.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    institution_name,
    principal_balance,
    balance_ratio_percent
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rn <= 300
ORDER BY institution_name ASC, balance_ratio_percent DESC, loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    COALESCE(SUM(ls.overdue_principal), 0) AS overdue_principal_total,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id AND ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING overdue_installment_count >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, overdue_principal_total DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE loan_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND disbursed_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.party_id
FROM
    account_holder t1
    INNER JOIN account t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
    INNER JOIN term_deposit t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id
    INNER JOIN credit_agreement t4 ON t1.party_id = t4.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    t2.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND t4.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    t1.party_id
ORDER BY
    t1.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    sm.person_party_id
FROM
    staff_member sm
WHERE
    sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sm.person_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            ah.party_id
        FROM
            account_holder ah
    )
ORDER BY
    sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id
FROM
    account a
WHERE
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND a.account_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            pe.from_account_id
        FROM
            payment_event pe
        WHERE
            pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
    )
ORDER BY
    a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    t1.security_id,
    t1.guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment AS t1
WHERE t1.status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY t1.guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS maturity_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE maturity_bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(cl.security_id) AS link_count
FROM
    collateral_link cl
WHERE
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY
    link_count DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH AccountLoanStats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        repayment_account_id,
        loan_id,
        disbursed_on,
        disbursed_amount,
        loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on ASC) AS rn
    FROM AccountLoanStats
    WHERE loan_count >= 3
)
SELECT 
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    disbursed_amount,
    loan_count
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ABS(a_bs.ledger_balance - a_bs.available_balance)), 2) AS total_difference
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot a_bs ON a.account_id = a_bs.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE a_bs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND a_bs.ledger_balance > a_bs.available_balance
  AND (a_bs.ledger_balance - a_bs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.opening_principal,
    t.maturity_on,
    t.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT
    pc.card_id,
    pc.card_type,
    pc.issued_on
FROM payment_card pc
WHERE pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
ORDER BY pc.issued_on ASC, pc.card_id ASC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_payment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_payment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_payment_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
GROUP BY inst.institution_id, inst.institution_name
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > 0
    AND ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_payment_ratio ASC, inst.institution_name ASC;

WITH contract_totals AS (
    SELECT
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
)
SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    ct.total_disbursed AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / ct.total_disbursed, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN contract_totals ct ON ld.agreement_id = ct.agreement_id
WHERE ct.total_disbursed > 0
  AND ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / ct.total_disbursed > 90
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS actual_raise_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 6) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution inst ON wp.issuer_institution_id = inst.institution_id
GROUP BY inst.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

WITH borrower_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END) AS overdue_count,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
    HAVING overdue_count > 0 AND total_count > overdue_count
)
SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    bls.overdue_count,
    bls.total_count
FROM borrower_loan_stats bls
JOIN party p ON bls.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY bls.overdue_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
LEFT JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ca.borrower_party_id != pi.intended_payee_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    t.loan_id,
    t.uncleared_installment_count,
    ROUND(t.total_principal_due, 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM (
    SELECT
        rs.loan_id,
        COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS uncleared_installment_count,
        SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_principal_due
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    GROUP BY rs.loan_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
) t
ORDER BY t.total_principal_due DESC, t.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE l.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t1.security_type,
    t1.contract_amount,
    t2.display_name
FROM credit_agreement t1
JOIN party t2 ON t1.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
WHERE t1.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND t1.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY t1.contract_amount DESC, t1.agreement_id ASC

WITH institution_product_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.target_party_id AS borrower_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
      AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
),
loan_details AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.annual_interest_rate,
        ca.product_family,
        ca.institution_id,
        p.display_name AS borrower_name
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (SELECT borrower_id FROM related_borrowers)
)
SELECT 
    ld.borrower_name,
    ld.borrower_party_id,
    ld.annual_interest_rate,
    ipar.avg_rate,
    ROUND(ld.annual_interest_rate - ipar.avg_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM loan_details ld
JOIN institution_product_avg_rate ipar 
    ON ld.institution_id = ipar.institution_id 
    AND ld.product_family = ipar.product_family
WHERE ld.annual_interest_rate < ipar.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS 关联方甲方编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 关联方乙方编号,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS 关联关系名称
FROM
    party_relation pr
JOIN
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE
    rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loan_drawdown ld
        WHERE ld.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
        )
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loan_drawdown ld
        WHERE ld.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    rtc.relation_name_zh ASC,
    pr.relation_id ASC;

WITH group_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id AND egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE eg.effective_to IS NULL OR eg.effective_to >= '2026-06-30'
      AND egm.effective_to IS NULL OR egm.effective_to >= '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
    HAVING member_count >= 2
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE eg.effective_to IS NULL OR eg.effective_to >= '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    glb.group_name,
    glb.member_count,
    ROUND(glb.total_loan_balance, 2) AS total_loan_balance,
    ROUND(gc.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(glb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS balance_to_capital_ratio
FROM group_loan_balance glb
JOIN group_capital gc ON glb.exposure_group_id = gc.exposure_group_id
WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
  AND (glb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / gc.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY balance_to_capital_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account payer_acc ON pe.from_account_id = payer_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder payer_holder ON payer_acc.account_id = payer_holder.account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer_holder.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN account payee_acc ON pe.to_account_id = payee_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder payee_holder ON payee_acc.account_id = payee_holder.account_id
JOIN party payee ON payee_holder.party_id = payee.party_id

JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type

    party p

    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_sum
FROM
    repayment_schedule rs

    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id

WHERE
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'

ORDER BY

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beyond_90_days_count
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING expired_count >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM account a
JOIN account_holder ah1 ON a.account_id = ah1.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah2 ON a.account_id = ah2.account_id AND ah1.party_id < ah2.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah1.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

    rs.loan_id,

FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING total_overdue_principal > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT

    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY rs.principal_due DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution inst
JOIN credit_facility cf ON inst.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON cf.facility_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON inst.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    inst.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital
HAVING
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY
    disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
HAVING total_guaranteed_amount < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT

    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount

    credit_facility cf
JOIN
    institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type

    COUNT(*) AS record_count

    cf.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY
    cf.facility_type
ORDER BY
    record_count DESC;

FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pm ON ld.payment_mode = pm.payment_mode
GROUP BY
    pm.name_zh
ORDER BY
    record_count DESC;

WITH product_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM product_ranking
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT 
    group_id,
    product_count
FROM group_counts
WHERE product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY group_id ASC;

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id

  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY
    cf.facility_id
ORDER BY
    循环授信限额合计 DESC

JOIN payment_instruction t2
    ON t1.payment_mode = t2.payment_mode

    t2.name_zh AS entity_status_name_zh

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS loan_manager_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'LOAN_MANAGER'
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    loan_manager_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pv3.loan_id) AS cnt
FROM
    prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pv3
JOIN
    institution i ON pv3.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    pv3.event_code = 'ECL_STAGE_2'
    AND pv3.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND pv3.ratio_value < 0.5
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    cnt DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_total
FROM
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN
    loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    provision_gap_total DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    ABS(ABS(a_bs.ledger_balance)) AS ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot a_bs
    ON a.account_id = a_bs.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_primary
    ON a.account_id = ah_primary.account_id
    AND ah_primary.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_secondary
    ON a.account_id = ah_secondary.account_id
    AND ah_secondary.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND ah_primary.account_holder_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ah_secondary.account_holder_id IS NULL
  AND a_bs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY a_bs.ledger_balance DESC;

    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio

    AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')

GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount

JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id

    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON ls.loan_id = ps.loan_id

WITH internal_max AS (

),
external_max AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external_valuation
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_valuation, 2) AS max_internal_valuation,
    ROUND(em.max_external_valuation, 2) AS max_external_valuation,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_valuation - em.max_external_valuation, 2) AS valuation_difference
FROM collateral_asset ca
INNER JOIN internal_max im ON ca.collateral_id = im.collateral_id
INNER JOIN external_max em ON ca.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
WHERE im.max_internal_valuation > em.max_external_valuation
ORDER BY valuation_difference DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (

),
pledge_summary AS (

    (
        SELECT
            borrower_party_id,
            COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM

        WHERE
            ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
        GROUP BY
            borrower_party_id
    ) src_loan ON pr.source_party_id = src_loan.borrower_party_id

    (
        SELECT
            borrower_party_id,
            COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM
            credit_agreement ca
        WHERE
            ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
        GROUP BY

    ) tgt_loan ON pr.target_party_id = tgt_loan.borrower_party_id

    rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'

    AND tgt_loan.cnt IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id

WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount

ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount

JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
