HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS inverted_amount_sum,
    COUNT(phs.holding_id) AS inverted_holding_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY inverted_amount_sum DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    COALESCE(loan_overdue.total_overdue_principal, 0) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN party obligor ON ma.obligor_party_id = obligor.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
) loan_overdue ON obligor.party_id = loan_overdue.borrower_party_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_pledge_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_pledge_count
FROM
    collateral_link cl
WHERE
    cl.lien_priority = 1
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY
    high_pledge_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS asset_liability_ratio
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE
    fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY
    asset_liability_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(c.net_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM
    capital_snapshot c
JOIN
    institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND c.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY
    core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL
    AND fs.total_assets != 0
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

WITH inst_fin AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs
        ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
),
total_rev AS (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_annual_revenue
    FROM inst_fin
)
SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    ROUND(inst.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(inst.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total.total_annual_revenue, 6) AS revenue_ratio
FROM inst_fin inst
CROSS JOIN total_rev total
WHERE inst.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total.total_annual_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ma.originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE
    ma.valuation_method IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS count
FROM
    term_deposit td
JOIN
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    td.annual_interest_rate > 3.0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS cnt
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
  AND td.maturity_on < '2026-07-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    cnt DESC;

WITH ProvisionGap AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ps.loan_id,
        ps.as_of_date,
        ps.required_amount,
        ps.recognized_amount,
        (ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS shortfall_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
      AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
InstitutionShortfall AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(shortfall_amount) AS total_shortfall
    FROM ProvisionGap
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
InstitutionNetCapital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
Combined AS (
    SELECT
        isg.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        isg.total_shortfall,
        inc.net_capital,
        ROUND(isg.total_shortfall * 1.0 / inc.net_capital, 6) AS shortfall_ratio
    FROM InstitutionShortfall isg
    JOIN InstitutionNetCapital inc ON isg.institution_id = inc.institution_id
    JOIN institution i ON isg.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE inc.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    institution_name,
    ROUND(total_shortfall, 2) AS total_shortfall,
    ROUND(net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(shortfall_ratio * 100, 2) AS shortfall_percentage
FROM Combined
ORDER BY shortfall_ratio DESC, institution_id ASC;

SELECT
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY
    借据数量 DESC,
    风险分类名称 ASC;

WITH bad_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
        ROUND(SUM(dls.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot dls ON ld.loan_id = dls.loan_id
    JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
    WHERE dls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND dls.principal_overdue_days >= 90
      AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        fs.party_id,
        ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND fs.source_kind = 'AUDITED'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        bls.institution_id,
        bls.bad_loan_count,
        bls.total_overdue_principal,
        ir.annual_revenue,
        ROUND(bls.total_overdue_principal * 1.0 / NULLIF(ir.annual_revenue, 0), 6) AS overdue_to_revenue_ratio
    FROM bad_loan_stats bls
    LEFT JOIN institution_revenue ir ON ir.party_id = 'PTY-' || bls.institution_id
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    bad_loan_count,
    total_overdue_principal
FROM combined
WHERE overdue_to_revenue_ratio > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS principal_balance_sum,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY
    loan_to_rwa_ratio DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM
    payment_instruction pi
INNER JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY
    instruction_count DESC,
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

WITH institution_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        COUNT(r.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
        SUM(r.amount_value) AS abnormal_amount,
        fs.total_assets
    FROM institution i
    JOIN ai_system_record_v3 r ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON 'PTY-' || i.institution_id = fs.party_id
    WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.total_assets
    HAVING COUNT(r.record_id) >= 8
),
capital_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
    im.institution_name,
    im.abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(im.abnormal_amount, 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(cm.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(im.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(im.abnormal_amount * 1.0 / cm.net_capital * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital_pct
FROM institution_metrics im
JOIN capital_metrics cm ON im.institution_id = cm.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio_to_net_capital_pct DESC;

WITH institution_provision_gap AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
regulatory_overdue AS (
    SELECT 
        rse.institution_id,
        COUNT(rse.record_id) AS overdue_record_count,
        ROUND(AVG(rse.amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount_value
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse
    JOIN regulatory_event_catalog rec ON rse.event_code = rec.event_code
    WHERE rse.as_of_date = '2026-06-30' -- 假设 event_date 或 as_of_date 为基准，此处根据 schema 无 as_of_date，使用 event_date 或默认最新。根据 schema，regulatory_submission_event_v3 无 as_of_date，只有 event_date。
    -- 修正：regulatory_submission_event_v3 没有 as_of_date 字段，只有 event_date。题目要求“监管报送事项中已逾期未完成记录”。
    -- 通常逾期指 deadline_date < current_date 且 completion_date IS NULL 或 status_code 表示未完成。
    -- 但题目未给出具体状态码含义，仅给出 event_code 关联。
    -- 根据 schema，regulatory_submission_event_v3 有 deadline_date, completion_date, status_code, exception_flag.
    -- 假设“已逾期未完成”定义为：deadline_date < '2026-06-30' AND (completion_date IS NULL OR status_code != 'COMPLETED')。
    -- 由于没有明确的“完成”状态码，通常 exception_flag=1 或 status_code 包含 'OVERDUE'/'PENDING' 等。
    -- 但题目未提供 status_code 的具体值域。
    -- 重新审视题目：“监管报送事项中已逾期未完成记录”。
    -- 结合 schema，regulatory_submission_event_v3 有 deadline_date。
    -- 假设逾期为 deadline_date < '2026-06-30'。
    -- 假设未完成为 completion_date IS NULL。
    -- 这是一个合理的监管数据查询假设。
    WHERE rse.deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
      AND rse.completion_date IS NULL
    GROUP BY rse.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(ro.overdue_record_count, 0) AS overdue_record_count,
    ro.avg_amount_value,
    COALESCE(ipg.insufficient_provision_count, 0) AS insufficient_provision_count,
    COALESCE(ipg.provision_gap_amount, 0.00) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN institution_provision_gap ipg ON i.institution_id = ipg.institution_id
LEFT JOIN regulatory_overdue ro ON i.institution_id = ro.institution_id
WHERE COALESCE(ro.overdue_record_count, 0) >= 25
ORDER BY provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.ratio_value END), 4) AS avg_abnormal_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非“非关联方”关系笔数
FROM
    related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN
    party p ON rtr.subject_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE
    rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY
    关联目标主体数 DESC,
    关系种类数 DESC,
    客户名称 ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
risk_stats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(record_id) AS valid_event_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(record_id) >= 43
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cs.valid_card_count,
    cs.cardholder_count,
    rs.abnormal_amount,
    rs.valid_event_count
FROM risk_stats rs
JOIN institution i ON rs.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON rs.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY rs.abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(r.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 r ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(r.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

WITH asset_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.originator_institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount
    FROM managed_asset ma
    GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
),
custody_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_record_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN c.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum
    FROM custody_operation_event_v3 c
    GROUP BY c.institution_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    a.asset_count,
    a.total_issued_amount,
    c.valid_record_count,
    c.abnormal_amount_sum
FROM asset_stats a
JOIN custody_stats c ON a.originator_institution_id = c.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON a.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY a.total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
